challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Casey's repeated initiation and approximately weekly one-on-one time show sustained interest and weaken a purely convenience-based interpretation.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner demonstrate meaningful effort and responsiveness to Drew's priorities.
Casey's independent resumption of contact after periods apart indicates continuity of interest rather than reliance on Drew to maintain the connection.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: The challenge facts materially strengthen A, so confidence in B is reduced. B remains slightly better supported because Casey twice declined to define the relationship without a timeline, generally favored short-notice or nearby meetings, canceled two advance plans for other commitments, did not introduce Drew to close friends or family, and declined a two-month-ahead event because of the planning horizon. The record supports meaningful interest, but more clearly supports limited commitment.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Drew could clarify what Casey is presently willing to offer and assess whether that level of involvement meets Drew's needs, without assuming either disinterest or future commitment.
